# 100.00 USD parked in a USD account, against the 100.00 USD invoice.
#
# The single-currency shape on the happy path, and the common one: money
# arrives, nobody knows yet what it settles, so it is booked to
# `Assets:Suspense USD`, in the same currency it arrived in. Bank,
# `Assets:Suspense USD`, receivable and invoice are all USD, so the entry is
# USD and nothing converts.
#
# Every other Q-039 fixture parks CAD against a USD invoice, which is the
# shape the issue reported. This is the one where the parked figure happens to
# be right — linking it must still work, and must still land the receivable at
# what the bank received rather than at whatever that split said.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, bank +100 against suspense
# −100, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-02 * "Money in, USD suspense"
	guid: "abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "bcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789a"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Suspense USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "cdef0123456789abcdef0123456789ab"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
